headline: Maui County Independent Nomination Board

meeting.summary: The Independent Nomination Board met at 4:57 p.m. on October 17.
meeting.recap: The Independent Nomination Board met at 4:57 p.m. on October 17.[[0:00:30]] No applicants were scheduled for interviews, so that item was put off.[[0:02:45]] Members voted unanimously to change question marks to periods in two draft letters.[[0:08:27]] The board voted unanimously to approve the edited letters.[[0:09:20]] A member resigned from the South Maui advisory committee, effective October 7, 2024.[[0:10:40]] The board met in executive session (a closed-door discussion) with its attorney.[[0:15:39]] Members voted to let one person approve a board letter to the mayor's office, council and department heads.[[0:16:28]] The board voted unanimously to repeat past recruiting ads and add LinkedIn and radio.[[0:37:33]] Members voted to divide the open boards so each member writes up what three boards need.[[0:48:36]] In a second executive session, the board chose to skip reviewing existing applications for now.[[1:00:39]] The meeting recessed at 6:41 p.m.[[1:16:01]] The next meeting will be fully remote.[[1:16:28]]
decided: The applicant interview item was put off because no one was scheduled; no vote was taken.
The amendment to replace question marks with periods in both letters passed unanimously.
The board voted unanimously to go into executive session to consult its attorney.
The board gave one person authority to approve a letter on its behalf to the mayor's office, council and department heads.
The board approved splitting the open boards into groups of three, assigned to each member.
meeting.next: Staff will work with the communications team and report back on the 23rd. Members may invite the personnel services director to a meeting in January to discuss the auditor search. The board may return to existing applications in next week's continued meeting. Members have homework to complete before next week's remote meeting.
